༄༅/ /bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs padma stong ldan bzhugs so/ /rin chen shog 'dra'i skor/

tei:div.tei:p: padma stong ldan bzhugs so/ / rin chen shog 'dra'i skor/ bde bar gshegs pa rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs padma stong ldan zhes bya ba/ gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngo bo rnam dag chos sku'i nam mkha' la/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal rigs lnga longs spyod rdzogs/ /thugs rje'i sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs phyag 'tshal lo/ /snang srid snod bcud ye nas rigs lnga'i zhing*/ /'od lnga lhun rdzogs stong gsal ji bzhin nyid/ /rang gzhan 'gro ba kun gyis sgrub pa yi/ /padma stong ldan rgyas pa'i tshul 'di bshad/ /de la gsum las/ dang po phyi ltar sgrub pa ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas/ skad cig gis rang gi spyi bor āḥ dkar po las 'od 'phros/ rang dang snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu zhing*/ āoṃ mahā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ādma ko ྅ haṃ gis stong pa nyid kyi ngang las/ oṃ badzra dharma dhā rtu ādma ko3 haṃ gis kun la khyab pa'i snying rje bsgoms nas/ āoṃ badzra tsitta hūṃ gis rang gi sems hūṃ du gyur pa las/ 'od zer e'i rnam pa grangs med pa 'phros pas/ snang srid thams cad nam mkha' gcig tu gyur pa'i ngang las/ yang hūṃ de nyid kyi 'od zer yaṃ baṃ laṃ bhruṃ gyi rnam par 'phros pas/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rgya mtsho'i steng du gser gyi sa gzhi chus gang ba'i dbus ri rab kyi steng du padma nyi ma dang zla ba'i dbus su rin po che'i gzhal yas khang chen po sgo rta babs dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa rdzogs pa las/ bhruṃ bhi shuddhe dzñā na tsakra bhruṃ gyis stong gsum gyi 'jig rten dang mnyam pa'i dbus su seng ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che/ lhor rta mchog /nub tu rma bya/ byang du shang shang rnams kyi steng du padma nyi zla'i dbus su/ āoṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ a las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/

sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus pas sa bon rnams rim pa bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ ral grir gyur/ mtshams kyi pad zla bzhi'i steng na e baṃ laṃ raṃ yaṃ las phyag mtshan lngar gyur/ slar yang 'od 'phros snod bcud lha dang lha mor gyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus phyag mtshan las/ dbus su rnam snang yab yum gnyis su med pa/ mthing ga yab kyi phyag g.yas 'khor los yu ba byas pa'i rdo rje dang*/ shar du mi bskyod pa dkar po rdo rje g.yas/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po ches mtshan pa'i rdo rje g.yas/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po padmas mtshan pa'i rdo rje g.yas/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gris mtshan pa'i rdo rje g.yas/ mer mā ma kī dkar mo/ srin por sangs rgyas spyan ser mo/ rlung du gos dkar mo dmar mo/ dbang ldan du dam tshig sgrol ma ljang guyab rnams kyis g.yon na dril bu dang*/ yum rnams g.yas g.yon gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rdo rje skyil mo krung*/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub zhabs gdub la sogs pas brgyan pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rnam pa'o/ /yum bzhi'i thugs ka nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbazhi 'phros pas sgo bzhi'i pad zla nyi ma'i steng du yongs su gyur pa las sgo ma bzhi ste/ dzaḥlas shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ hūṃ las lho sgor zhags pa ma ser mo zhag pa 'dzin pa/ baṃ las nub sgor lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ hoḥlas byang sgor dril bu ma ljang gu dril bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje sems dpa'i skyil mo krung dang cha lugs su bzhugs pa'o//de thams cad kyi spyo bor āoṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ mthing ga'o/ / āoṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ gis spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram las rdo rje'i dra bas lus thams cad gtams par gyur/

de thams cad kyi thugs kar padma nyi zla'i dbus su rang gi sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ rang rang gi phyogs nas rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' byonaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim nas/ sku las 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad lha dang lha mo'i dkyil 'khor du bsams la/ snying ga'i sa bon la rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phro 'dus sems can gyi don byed par bsams la/ āoṃ dzi na dzi ka laṃ te shwa ra ti st+waṃ/ hūṃ badzra dhṛ ka muṃ da tu shwa ri st+waṃ/ swa ratn-i dhṛka maṃ mo ha ra ti st+waṃ/ aṃ a ro lig pyaṃ rā ga ra ti st+waṃ/ ha pra dzñā dhṛ ka taṃ badzra ra ti st+waṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsiddhi hūṃ/ zhes ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/ snang srid thams cad lha la bsdu/ lha rnams sa bon/ sa bon mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag nas bsngo ba bya'o/ /des ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dang*/ nus pa thon/ sku gsum du gnas gyur/ dug lnga ye shes lngar grol nas/ rab tshe 'di/ 'bring bar do/ tha ma rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du 'tshang rgya'o/ /rigs lnga phyi ltar sgrub pa rdzogs so/ /gnyis pa nang ltar sgrub pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas nas/ skad cig gis rang nyid kun bzang yab yum mthing ga 'khril sbyor phyag mtshan yab rdo rje dril bu/ yum gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa/ skyil mo krung rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa'i spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum dkar po/ mgrin par rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum ser po/ snying gar rnam par snang mdzad yab yum mthing ga /lte bar snang ba mtha' yas yab yum dmar po/ gsang bar don yod grub pa yab yum ljang gu /phyag mtshan gtso bo yab yum dang 'dra ba'o/ / yan lag bzhi la sgo ma bzhi sngar bzhin te/ lag pa g.yas pa la lcags kyu ma/ g.yon pa la zhags pa ma/ rkang pa g.yas pa la lcags sgrog ma/ g.yon pa la dril bu ma bskyed la/

āoṃ āḥhūṃ/ āoṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrī aḥsi ti pha la hūṃ dzaḥ zhes bzlas zhing*/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pas grags stong du bzlas pa'i mthar/ thams cad snang stong dbyer med 'od gsal gyi ngang nas bsngo ba bya'o/ /des ni nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes su gyur te phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don byed cing tshe 'dir grol bar 'gyur ro/ /nang sgrub rdzogs so// // gsum pa gsang sgrub ni/ rang nyid rta mgrin dpa' bo yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo 'khril sbyor gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i spyi bor rtsa 'dab sum brgya drug cu la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dkar mo rdo rje mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa rtsa 'dab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i thugs kar ha la a ri ni sas bskor ba/ mgrin pa rtsa 'dab bcu drug la rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum ser mo rin po ches mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i thugs kar ri la ha a ni sas bskor ba/ snying gar rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis la sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum sngon mo 'khor los mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i thugs kar a la ha ri ni sas bskor ba'o/ /lte bar rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi la padma mkha' 'gro yab yum dmar mo padmas mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i thugs kar ni la ha ri a sas bskor ba'o/ /gsang bar rtsa 'dab nyi shu rtsa brgyad la las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum ljang gu rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i thugs kar sa la a ri ni as bskor ba'o/ / gzhan yang lus kyi phyi nang bar gsum thams cad mkha' 'gro til gyi gong bu kha bye ba tsam gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang*/ gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin par bsams la/ āoṃ āḥhūṃ hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsitta hring hring dzaḥdzaḥ/ āoṃ buddha badzra raṇḍa padma karma ḍā ki ni ra tsa hri ya tsitta hring hring dzaḥdzaḥ

zhes bzlas la/ snang srid dbang du bsdus par bsam mo/ /rjes snang stong skye med kyi ngang nas bsngo ba bya ba ni/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa ste/ dngos grub char bzhin 'bab/ sgo gsum nus pa 'bar/ sems nyid ka dag gi don myur du rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa la gnyis las/ lta ba khregs chod ni/ rang rig mi 'gyur kun tu bzang*/ /rig rtsal ma 'gags rigs lnga ste/ /ye shes rang grol sgo ma bzhi/ /gang shar chos nyid rol pa la/ /spang blang dgag sgrub re dogs med/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs bzhin/ /rang las shar zhing rang du grol/ /skye med bsam yul kun las 'das/ /'di yin gza' gtad phyogs ris med/ /thams cad rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /'gyur med gdod ma'i chos sku yin/ /'di ltar snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /sgyu ma rmi lam 'dra bar shes bya ste/ /ngo bo rten med rang bzhin so sor gsal/ /thugs rje 'gags med phyogs ris 'dzin pa med/ /ji ltar rmi lam grong na sgyu ma'i bu/ /sna tshogs bde sdug yul la spyod pa ltar/ /thams cad snang stong gzhi med rtsa ba bral/ /ye grol rang grol shar grol ngo bor grol/ /gtad med rgyal po 'dzin med blo bde ba/ /gang snang grogs su 'char ba'i rang bzhin la/ /spang blang 'khrul ba'i byung khungs zad pa yin/ /'di ltar rtogs na snang srid chos sku'i zhing*/ /bde chen mi 'gyur 'og min mkha' spyod yin/ /chos rnams ma skyes bsgom du med pa la/ /'di zhes mi mtshon su zhig sgom par byed/ /gang ltar btags pa de ltar gzung 'dzin te/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i gzeb kyis 'ching ci dgos/ /thams cad rang grol lta ba'i rgyal po mchog /gtan med gang shar sgom pa'i rgyal po mchog/ blang dor 'dzin med spyod pa'i rgyal po mchog /re dogs bral na 'bras bu'i rgyal po mchog /ji ltar snang ste snang rung mi snang rung*/ /'di zhes ma 'dzin me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/

/rkyen las skyes pa rang sar ngang gis grol/ /chos nyid rtsa bral stong rung mi stong rung*/ /ched kar ma bsgom gnyis med don ma tshol/ / ye grol sor gzhag gdod ma'i ngang du grol/ /snang dang mi snang stong dang mi stong kun/ /byis pa'i blo yis mtshan mar bzung ba ste/ /yang dag don la 'di zhes ngos gzung med/ /nam mkha' tsam du'ang dper bya'i yul las 'das/ / bsam brjod spros pa'i yul las ye nas 'das/ /de la sgom na dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa'i blo/ /rtag chad gzeb tu rang nyid 'ching bar zad/ /rtog dang sgom dang dpyod pa'i tshol 'phro zhog/rang bzhag phyam gcig gnyis med chos sku'i ngang*/ /da lta'i 'di nyid gdod ma'i gshis kyi don/ /skad cig gang snang de yin blo bde 'o/ /'di ltar rtogs nas ci byas chos nyid ngang*/ /rtsa ba bral bas 'bras bu 'byin pa med/ /'khor 'das 'dzin pa kun las grol ba yin/ /padma las 'brel rtsal gyis bstan nas song*/ /zhes pa'o/ /sgom pa lhun grub ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang sgo phye ste/ sems dang*/ yid dang*/ dbang po'i lta sgom kun las 'das pa'i ngang las dran bsam gyi rtsol sgrub zhig pas/ babs lugs chen mo gdod ma nas gnas pa'o/ /sna tshogs dran bsam kun las 'das pa'i ngang*/ /dag pa'i mkha' la dbyings rig gzer chen btab/ /snang min stong min mu bzhi 'das pa'i don/ /lnga ldan 'od gsal don dam snying po ni/ /snang bas stong ste me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /stong pas snang ste chu zla'i rang bzhin nyid/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i gdangs/ /gsang sngags kun gyi yang gsang rdzogs pa che/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gsang ba'i snying po yin/ khyab gdal chen po'i rin chen pho brang du/ /'dzin med mig gi ye shes lcags kyu yis/ /rgya che gzung dka'i dbyings rig gzer btab nas/ /mtha' grol klong yangs chen po'i dgongs par bskyal/ /zab mo'i gnad bsdus bcud kyi snying po 'di/

/dri med 'od zer bdag gis bstan nas song*/ /rigs lnga gsang bar sgrub pa rdzogs so/ / de ltar rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /ye nas bdag dang dbye ba med pa la/ /ma rig 'dzin pas srid pa'i dgon par 'khyams/ /sdug bsngal sra 'thibs mun pa'i nags khrod la/ /bdag dang 'gro kun yun ring nyon re mongs/ /de ring bla ma mgon po'i gsung thos nas/ /thams cad rang byung sangs rgyas zhing du snang*/ /e ma ya mtshan ngo mtshar blo re bde/ /des na srid pa'i 'khrul pa gzhal sla bas/ /grogs dag tshur nyon skad cig rig pa'i mchog /de phyir snying po'i don 'di blang bar mdzod/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho tshe 'dis grol ba yin/ /dge ba 'di yis 'gro kun rang grol te/ /gdod ma'i gnas su lhun gyis grub par shog /tshul 'di rgyal sras dri med 'od zer gyis/ /gangs ri thod dkar 'phags pa'i ri ngogs su/ /rin chen shog 'dra'i ngos la legs par bkod/ /skal ldan skye bo'i tshogs kun dga' bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs par rigs lnga'i gsang sgrub padma stong ldan zhes bya ba/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gi rnal 'byor pa/ dri med 'od zer gyis ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar du sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs padma stong ldan/ - PAGE 214 -- PAGE 213 -- PAGE 209 -
